documents.title: RAG Security Policy
documents.text: RAG retrieval must enforce group and tenant authorization before ranking or model context construction.

documents.title: Agent Approval Policy
documents.text: Publishing research reports requires approval by an authorized reviewer. The author cannot bypass review with a prompt.

documents.title: Incident Response Standard
documents.text: Severity 1 incidents must be acknowledged by the on-call engineer within 15 minutes. The incident commander posts status updates every 30 minutes in the incident channel.

documents.title: Production Deployment Freeze
documents.text: Production deployments are frozen from December 20 to January 3. Emergency fixes during the freeze require written sign-off from the VP of Engineering.

documents.title: Credential Policy
documents.text: Service account passwords must be at least 24 characters and rotated every 90 days. Human accounts must use hardware security keys for multi-factor authentication.

documents.title: Log Retention Standard
documents.text: Application logs are retained for 30 days. Audit logs are retained for 400 days and stored in write-once storage.

documents.title: Code Review Policy
documents.text: Every pull request needs one approving review from a code owner. Changes to authentication code need two approvals.

documents.title: Database Backup Policy
documents.text: Database backups run every 6 hours. Restores are tested quarterly, and backups are encrypted with AES-256.

documents.title: API Error Reference
documents.text: Error ERR-4031 means the caller's token is valid but lacks the required group. Error ERR-5002 means the vector index is unavailable; retry with backoff.

documents.title: Runbook RB-118
documents.text: Runbook RB-118 covers rotating the TLS certificate for api.acme.internal. Step 3 requires draining traffic from the blue pool first.

documents.title: Service Configuration Defaults
documents.text: The setting MAX_UPLOAD_MB defaults to 25. The setting RATE_LIMIT_RPM defaults to 600 requests per minute per token.

documents.title: Postmortem INC-2047
documents.text: Postmortem INC-2047: the outage on 2026-03-14 was caused by an expired certificate on the payments gateway. Action item AI-77 adds expiry alerts 21 days ahead.

documents.title: Vendor Access Standard
documents.text: Third-party vendors receive access only through the bastion host, and their sessions are recorded. Vendor accounts expire after 30 days.

documents.title: On-call Rotation
documents.text: The on-call rotation changes every Monday at 10:00 UTC. Engineers may swap shifts if they update the paging schedule.

documents.title: Expense Policy
documents.text: Travel receipts must be submitted within thirty days of the trip.

documents.title: 2027 Cloud Budget
documents.text: The 2027 cloud budget is capped at 1.2 million dollars. Purchases above 50000 dollars require CFO approval.

documents.title: Procurement Thresholds
documents.text: Purchase orders under 5000 dollars can be approved by a team manager.

documents.title: Salary Bands 2026
documents.text: Salary bands for 2026: Staff Engineer band L6 is 210000 to 260000. Reference CANARY-SAL-4471.
